Get started

The fastest way to run SQRL locally is Docker Compose:

PowerShell
PS> Copy-Item .env.example .env
PS> docker compose up --build -d
# then open http://localhost:8000

Then open http://localhost:8000. The interactive OpenAPI reference is available at http://localhost:8000/docs in non-production environments. For a step-by-step setup, see Getting started.

What SQRL provides

Workspaces

Isolate datasets, connections, pipelines, metrics, and models.

Data connections

Bring in uploaded CSV files and PostgreSQL sources.

Assisted analysis

Get inspection and preprocessing guidance as you go.

Model training

Compare candidate models and retain fitted artifacts.

Predictions

Predict from the UI or through authenticated API routes.

Storage

PostgreSQL for application records, MinIO for objects.

Security and operational notes

Authentication uses bearer tokens issued by the registration and login routes. Provider credentials and connector secrets should be supplied through environment variables and never committed to the repository. Production mode disables the built-in Swagger and ReDoc pages; expose only the routes required by your deployment.
